stats AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
           AVG(x) AS mean_x,
           AVG(y) AS mean_y,

    FROM combined
)

model_details.model_sql:
WITH date_parts AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(SUBSTR(date, 1, INSTR(date, ' ') - 1)) AS dt_str
  FROM Crime
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT
    dt_str,
    CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(dt_str, INSTR(dt_str, '/') + 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(dt_str, INSTR(dt_str, '/') + 1), '/') - 1)) AS INTEGER) AS day_num,
    CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(dt_str, INSTR(SUBSTR(dt_str, INSTR(dt_str, '/') + 1), '/') + INSTR(dt_str, '/') + 1)) AS INTEGER) AS year_num,
    CAST(TRIM(SUBSTR(dt_str, 1, INSTR(dt_str, '/') - 1)) AS INTEGER) AS month_num
  FROM date_parts
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT
    printf('%04d-%02d-%02d', year_num, month_num, day_num) AS iso_date
  FROM parsed
),
with_dow AS (
  SELECT
    CASE CAST(strftime('%w', iso_date) AS INTEGER)
      WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday'
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday'
    END AS weekday
  FROM formatted
)
SELECT weekday, COUNT(*) AS crime_count
FROM with_dow
GROUP BY weekday
SELECT Weekday, AVG(Sentiment) AS avg_sentiment FROM twitter GROUP BY Weekday
